parts.t: Centrally located and highly accessible, Central Burnaby puts you within reach of everything the city has to offer. With a variety of housing options and proximity to Burnaby Mountain, Deer Lake, and SkyTrain, it's one of the most practical and desirable places to live in the Lower Mainland.
